basics.summary: Fourth-year Ph.D. student in Computer Science at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (UIUC). Research focuses on network science, specifically detection and analysis of community structures in large and complex networks.

work.summary: Research on network science, community detection, and analysis of community structures in large and complex networks. Advised by Professor Tandy Warnow.

publications.name: EC-SBM Synthetic Network Generator
publications.summary: Proposes the Edge-Connected Stochastic Block Model (EC-SBM), a new synthetic network generator that produces networks resembling real-world clustered networks with respect to both network and community-specific criteria.

publications.name: RECCS: Realistic Cluster Connectivity Simulator for Synthetic Network Generation
publications.summary: Describes RECCS, a technique that modifies Stochastic Block Model synthetic networks to improve fit to cluster edge connectivity in real-world networks.

publications.name: Synthetic Networks That Preserve Edge Connectivity
publications.publisher: Proceedings of 13th International Conference on Complex Networks & Their Applications
publications.summary: Introduces RECCS applied to stochastic block models to produce synthetic networks with better cluster edge connectivity than unmodified SBMs.

publications.name: Improved Community Detection using Stochastic Block Models
publications.publisher: Proceedings of 13th International Conference on Complex Networks & Their Applications
publications.summary: Demonstrates that SBM software produces poorly-connected clusters and presents simple modifications to improve connectivity and accuracy.

publications.name: Expand BERT Representation with Visual Information via Grounded Language Learning with Multimodal Partial Alignment
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia
publications.summary: Proposes GroundedBERT, a grounded language learning method that enhances BERT representations with visually grounded information using Partial Optimal Transport.

publications.name: Improving Mini-batch Optimal Transport via Partial Transportation
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the 39th International Conference on Machine Learning
publications.summary: Proposes mini-batch partial optimal transport (m-POT) to address misspecified mappings in standard mini-batch optimal transport methods.
